intro: Seafaring comfort food: salt cod in a thousand ways, grilled sardines, pork and the world's favourite custard tart. It reached Hong Kong via Macau.
flavours: Bacalhau (salt cod), olive oil, garlic, piri-piri, bay leaf
hk: Macau's Macanese cooking is Portuguese-Chinese fusion; the Macau egg tart is the Lord Stow's descendant of the pastel de nata.

dishes.name: Pastel de nata
dishes.what: Flaky custard tart with a scorched top, invented by monks at Belém in Lisbon.

dishes.name: Bacalhau à Brás
dishes.what: Shredded salt cod scrambled with matchstick fries, onions and eggs, topped with olives.

dishes.name: Grilled sardines
dishes.what: Whole sardines charcoal-grilled with sea salt, the smell of Lisbon's June festivals.

dishes.name: Francesinha
dishes.what: Porto's monster sandwich of meats under melted cheese and a beer-tomato sauce, with fries.

dishes.name: Caldo verde
dishes.what: Green soup of potato and finely shredded kale with a slice of chouriço.

dishes.name: Bifana
dishes.what: Garlicky marinated pork steak in a crusty roll, a classic snack.

dishes.name: Piri-piri chicken
dishes.what: Grilled chicken basted with fiery bird's-eye chilli oil.
